purpose: Sensitivity model, not measured capacity, offer, invoice or full platform budget
owner_selected_scale: tylko kilkanascie tworcow i 10 tys widzow; reply to peak concurrent viewer question

assumption_notes.segment_seconds: Source default 6s; rendition/segment layout and overhead vary
assumption_notes.rungs: Source maximum ladder 5, smaller inputs produce fewer; average ladder bitrate 10 Mbps is unmeasured
assumption_notes.multipart_part_bytes: Declared policy default 16 MiB, not observed production upload mix
assumption_notes.storage: Constant catalogue as average daily peak; no new-catalogue growth, old versions, backups, thumbnail/subtitle bytes unless multiplier changed
assumption_notes.requests: Aggregate one segment stream per viewer, 6 extra requests and 20% overhead are assumptions; use actual telemetry later
assumption_notes.r2_cache: Assumed request-weighted hit ratio; CPU modeled before/in Worker and not reduced automatically by R2 hits
assumption_notes.encoding: RTF=2 and 70% time available are assumptions; no FFmpeg capacity benchmark
assumption_notes.allowances: One account's free/included allowances applied once per scenario; other account usage assumed zero

excluded_unpriced: account's unrelated traffic and extra API/control-plane requests
